ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure has three horizontal phase lines, labeled R, Y, B from top to bottom on the left. On the right side there is a triangular phase-sequence indication/connection mark composed of black nodes and diagonal lines; the upper node corresponds to the top R phase, the node on the middle horizontal line corresponds to the Y phase, and the lower-right node corresponds to the bottom B phase through the right-side connection. Reasoning: Read the phase lines in order according to the phase-sequence progression indicated by the triangle in the figure, obtaining R followed by Y followed by B. Therefore the phase sequence of this three-phase system is RBY.
